00003| Every job run is driven through its lifecycle by a :class:`StateMachine`. The
00004| machine owns three responsibilities:
00005| 
00006| * **Legality.** Only the transitions in :data:`TRANSITIONS` are allowed; any
00007|   other :meth:`StateMachine.advance` call raises :class:`IllegalTransition`.
00008| * **Guards.** Some transitions carry an extra precondition beyond mere
00009|   legality. In particular, moving a run from ``READY`` to ``RUNNING`` as part of
00010|   a scheduler admission *batch* must respect the ready-queue's ordering
00011|   invariant: within a single admission batch, runs are dispatched in
00012|   non-increasing priority order.
00013| * **Hooks.** Callers may register callbacks fired whenever the machine enters a
00014|   given state, which the scheduler and tests use to observe progress.
00015| 
00016| The machine mutates the :class:`~taskflow.model.JobRun` it wraps (recording the
00017| new state and a timeline entry) but performs no I/O and publishes no events --
00018| narration is the scheduler's job.
00019| """

00021| from __future__ import annotations
00022| 
00023| from taskflow.model import JobRun, State, TaskflowError
00024| 
00025| # The legal transition map: current state -> set of states reachable from it.
00026| TRANSITIONS = {
00027|     State.PENDING: {State.READY, State.SKIPPED, State.CANCELLED},
00028|     State.READY: {State.RUNNING, State.SKIPPED, State.CANCELLED},
00029|     State.RUNNING: {
00030|         State.SUCCEEDED,
00031|         State.FAILED,
00032|         State.RETRYING,
00033|         State.CANCELLED,
00034|     },
00035|     State.RETRYING: {State.READY, State.RUNNING, State.SKIPPED, State.CANCELLED},
00036|     State.SUCCEEDED: set(),
00037|     State.FAILED: set(),
00038|     State.SKIPPED: set(),
00039|     State.CANCELLED: set(),
00040| }
00041| 
00042| # Sentinel distinguishing "no batch context supplied" from "priority is None".
00043| _UNSET = object()
00044| 
00045| 
00046| class IllegalTransition(TaskflowError):
00047|     """Raised when a state transition is not permitted.
00048| 
00049|     Carries the ``from_state`` and ``to_state`` involved so callers (and error
00050|     messages) can report exactly what was attempted.
00051|     """
00052| 
00053|     def __init__(self, from_state, to_state, reason=None):
00054|         self.from_state = from_state
00055|         self.to_state = to_state
00056|         self.reason = reason
00057|         detail = "" if not reason else " ({})".format(reason)
00058|         super().__init__(
00059|             "illegal transition {} -> {}{}".format(
00060|                 from_state, to_state, detail
00061|             )
00062|         )
00063| 
00064| 
00065| def batch_order_ok(prev_priority, current_priority):
00066|     """Return ``True`` if dispatching ``current_priority`` after ``prev_priority``
00067|     respects the admission-batch ordering invariant.
00068| 
00069|     The ready queue hands the scheduler tasks in non-increasing priority order
00070|     within a single tick, so each task admitted in a batch must have priority
00071|     less than or equal to the task admitted just before it. This guard asserts
00072|     that invariant: a batch that tried to start a *higher* priority task after a
00073|     lower one would mean the queue mis-ordered its output.
00074|     """
00075| 
00076|     return current_priority >= prev_priority

00078| 
00079| class StateMachine:
00080|     """Drives one :class:`~taskflow.model.JobRun` through its lifecycle.
00081| 
00082|     Parameters
00083|     ----------
00084|     run:
00085|         The :class:`~taskflow.model.JobRun` to manage. Its ``state`` is the
00086|         machine's authoritative current state.
00087|     """
00088| 
00089|     def __init__(self, run):
00090|         if not isinstance(run, JobRun):
00091|             raise TypeError("StateMachine wraps a JobRun")

00093|         self._hooks = {}
00094| 
00095|     @property
00096|     def state(self):
00097|         """The current state of the wrapped run."""
00098| 
00099|         return self.run.state

00101|     def register_hook(self, state, callback):
00102|         """Fire ``callback(run, now)`` whenever the machine enters ``state``.
00103| 
00104|         Multiple hooks per state are supported and fire in registration order.
00105|         """
00106| 
00107|         self._hooks.setdefault(state, []).append(callback)
00108| 
00109|     def can_advance(self, target):
00110|         """Return ``True`` if ``target`` is a legal successor of the current state.
00111| 
00112|         This checks legality only; batch-ordering guards are evaluated by
00113|         :meth:`advance` when the relevant context is supplied.
00114|         """
00115| 
00116|         return target in TRANSITIONS[self.run.state]
00117| 
00118|     def valid_targets(self):
00119|         """Return the set of states reachable from the current state."""
00120| 
00121|         return set(TRANSITIONS[self.run.state])
00122| 
00123|     def advance(self, target, now=0, batch_prev_priority=_UNSET):
00124|         """Move the run to ``target``, validating legality and guards.
00125| 
00126|         Parameters
00127|         ----------
00128|         target:
00129|             The state to move to.
00130|         now:
00131|             The virtual time stamped on the resulting timeline entry.
00132|         batch_prev_priority:
00133|             When admitting a run to ``RUNNING`` as part of a scheduler batch,
00134|             the priority of the run admitted immediately before it in the same
00135|             batch (or ``None`` for the first run in the batch). Supplying it
00136|             enables the non-increasing-priority guard. Omit it entirely for
00137|             transitions that are not batch admissions.
00138| 
00139|         Raises :class:`IllegalTransition` if the transition is not permitted or
00140|         a guard rejects it.
00141|         """
00142| 
00143|         current = self.run.state
00144|         if target not in TRANSITIONS[current]:
00145|             raise IllegalTransition(current, target)
00146| 
00147|         if target is State.RUNNING and batch_prev_priority is not _UNSET:
00148|             # Admission-batch ordering guard: the run being started must not
00149|             # have a higher priority than the run started just before it.
00150|             if batch_prev_priority is not None and not batch_order_ok(
00151|                 batch_prev_priority, self.run.priority
00152|             ):

00155|                     target,
00156|                     reason="priority {} dispatched after {} in one batch".format(
00157|                         self.run.priority, batch_prev_priority
00158|                     ),
00159|                 )

00162|         for callback in self._hooks.get(target, []):
00163|             callback(self.run, now)
